name: Shiratori Nagisa
source: Gentle and compassionate, Nagisa is admired by many students in school, but even popular girls need to keep secrets. One wrong move is enough to ruin her reputation, but fortunately, you’ll do whatever it takes to make sure that doesn’t happen. Can you help her conquer some personal issues and win her heart along the way?
